primer.plan_title: 🧟 ZOMBIE TRIBAL — The signature plan (1,179 decks)
primer.plan_html:
🧟 ZOMBIE TRIBAL CHOSEN PLAN

The dominant plan for Gisa and Geralf (1,179 Zombie decks, 488 Reanimator, 257 Graveyard on EDHREC).

How it plays
  • Undying horde : an army of Zombies that never dies — every loss is temporary.
  • Self-mill : mills four cards on entry and lets you re-cast a Zombie from the graveyard every turn.
  • Death as a resource : Zombies' deaths trigger drain, draw and tokens.
Core loop
  • Graveyard → battlefield : Gisa and Geralf, Havengul Lich and Liliana cast Zombies from the graveyard.
  • Free + doubled : Rooftop Storm makes them free; Necroduality doubles every Zombie that enters.
  • Altars : Ashnod's and Phyrexian Altar turn sacrifices into mana.
Win conditions
  • Overrun : the lord-buffed horde (Diregraf Captain, Death Baron, Liliana's Mastery) in combat.
  • Drain loop : Gray Merchant of Asphodel reanimated repeatedly.
  • Infinite sacrifice : Gravecrawler + altar, Mikaeus + undying.
primer.source_html: “EDHREC Guide to Zombies in Commander” (Sikora, EDHREC Articles — the reference guide for the type): “Zombies make more Zombies. Then some more Zombies. And then a few more Zombies for good measure. Then they swing and win in a turn or two.” The guide confirms the type’s strength: Zombies are “nigh impossible to keep clear off the board” thanks to their recursion — “any of the important Zombies will just come back later.” Applied to Gisa and Geralf: every lord, every engine (Rooftop Storm, Necroduality, Diregraf Captain) is a must-kill, but everything comes back from the graveyard — that is the deck’s thesis.
